title: SpedUp
description: Sped Up loading and just quality improvements.
body:
This is a Modpack with recource packs and simple mods to make your minecraft experience _SpedUp_, feel free to expand the mdpack by adding your own mods such as _Create_ or _Minecraft Transit Railway_ without destroying your framerate.


![SpedUp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ee445412d2d62be7f1cf182f3e5b343cc063468_0.webp)

- CoroUtil
- DynamicFPS
- Entity Culling
- Fabric API
- FerriteCore
- FTQ Optimized
- Hero's Anchor Optimizer
- Immidiately Fast
- Immersive Optimization
- Indum
- Iris Shaders
- Lazy AI
- Lithium
- Many Loading Backgrounds recource packs
- Marlow's Crystal Optimizer
- Memory Leak Fix
- ModernFix
- Modern Painting
- Recourceful Config
- Seamless Loading Screen
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Structure Layout Optimizer


All of these mods are amazing in optimizing game performance from 10FPS to 100FPS
if you don't have a high quality PC or Computer.
